summary: Build bancassurance, digital onboarding, and partner governance skills in 5 days. Learn practical tools, workflows, and reporting.
lede: Bancassurance and insurtech connect insurance distribution through banking channels with digital tools for sales, servicing and underwriting. Designed for professionals who manage distribution, product governance or digital customer journeys, the course addresses ways to improve channel performance while maintaining customer suitability and conduct controls. Participants practice mapping onboarding and referral workflows, analyzing funnel performance and complaints, and creating partner scorecards and executive reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage or influence bancassurance distribution, insurance product governance, and insurtech-enabled customer journeys.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of banking or insurance operations, channel sales, or compliance processes. Prior experience with insurance products, customer onboarding, or partner governance is helpful. No coding is required, but familiarity with Excel, dashboards, and basic process mapping will help you get more value from the practical exercises. Advanced concepts such as API-based distribution, AI-assisted lead scoring, and automated controls are taught at an operational application level rather than engineering depth.
